support_claim: Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party, and the packet instructs that the registry link be treated as unresolved despite naming overlap between sales and billing labels.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing identity evidence and DISTINCT requires establishing distinctness; name compatibility between CRM NBA-102 ("Northbridge Analytics") and billing ("Northbridge Analytics Inc.") is insufficient, and the packet explicitly preserves multiple live registry candidates (including a Wyoming LLC) without resolving which entity contracts, so neither positive nor negative disposition is licensed.
